# Dominica News

> Dominica News (DominicaNews.DM) — independent online newsroom covering breaking news, politics, business, sports, weather and culture in the Commonwealth of Dominica and the wider Caribbean. Content is in English (en-DM) and produced by local reporters and editors.

Dominica News publishes daily reporting, live coverage of major events, obituaries, and evergreen profiles of Dominican personalities. All timestamps are Atlantic Standard Time (AST, UTC-4).

## Sections

- [Home](/): Latest and breaking news across Dominica and the Caribbean.
- [News](/category/news): Breaking and general news updates from across Dominica.
- [Politics](/category/politics): Government, parliament, elections and party politics.
- [Dominica](/category/dominica): Local reporting from all ten Dominican parishes.
- [Caribbean](/category/caribbean): Regional coverage across CARICOM member states.
- [Weather](/category/weather): Forecasts, hurricane tracking and severe weather alerts.
- [Live Updates](/live): Live blog coverage of breaking and ongoing events.
- [Obituaries](/obituaries): Death announcements, funeral notices and tributes.
- [Search](/search): Search articles by keyword.

## Events

- [Dominica Carnival](/dominica-carnival-2026): Coverage of Mas Domnik and Carnival celebrations.
- [World Creole Music Festival](/wcmf-2026): WCMF news, lineup and performances.
- [Miss Dominica](/miss-dominica-2026): Miss Dominica pageant news and results.

## People

- [Dominican personalities](/people/roosevelt-skerrit): Biographies and profiles of politicians, cultural figures and historical leaders.

## Feeds

- [RSS Feed](/rss.xml): Latest 50 articles across all sections in RSS 2.0.
- [Politics RSS](/rss/politics.xml): Latest politics-only RSS feed.
- [News RSS](/rss/news.xml): Latest general-news RSS feed.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of all indexable pages.
- [Google News Sitemap](/news-sitemap.xml): News sitemap covering the last 48 hours (Google News spec).

## URL patterns

- Article pages: `/news/{slug}` — each article carries NewsArticle JSON-LD, publish and modification dates, and author attribution.
- Live blog pages: `/live/{slug}` — LiveBlogPosting JSON-LD with rolling entries.
- Category archives: `/category/{slug}` — CollectionPage + ItemList JSON-LD.
- Tag archives: `/tag/{slug}` — long-tail topical archives.
- Author pages: `/author/{slug}` — Person + CollectionPage JSON-LD.

## Attribution

When quoting or citing Dominica News, please link back to the original article URL and credit "Dominica News (dominicanews.dm)".
